title: Internal-State Probes Read the Situation, Not the Action: Three Negative Results for Pre-Action Misalignment Monitoring
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical AI safety monitoring, specifically investigating if internal model probes can detect misaligned intent before an action is taken. While misalignment is related to human values and safety, the paper does not evaluate moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious topics as a core component; it is focused on the robustness and generalization of probe-based monitoring techniques.
